source.notes: 1,000,000 synthetic SimpleFeatures (2 bp each, an integer score, a strand) through encodeFeatures, four arms interleaved round-robin in one node 24 process on AC power, min of 9 rounds. Every arm packs x/x2/y, builds the Flatbush and skips the same features; the identity check compares count, x and y across arms first. 'native' reads score with feature.get and packs a constant colour; 'control' is the same encoding declared a second time, so its ratio is the harness's own resolution; 'jexl-y' reads score through a jexl: expression, one evaluation per feature; 'jexl-color' reads score natively and colours through a jexl ternary, one evaluation per feature with its CSS answer parsed once per distinct string. Absolute times drift about 2x between runs on this shared box; the within-run ratios held across three runs. 'vs native' is typed rather than derived because it divides by another row.
